title: 26Sept – Annual Day Celebrations @ Sophia College
summary: On 26th September, our Club members attended the Annual Day celebration of Sophia College for Women at Bhulabhai Desai Road, where the Jalan family has also sponsored an award as Rotary Mid-Town member.
description:
On 26th September, our Club members attended the Annual Day celebration of Sophia College for Women at Bhulabhai Desai Road, where the Jalan family has also sponsored an award as Rotary Mid-Town member.
The Celebrations were attended by 9 members and partners namely Rtn Anil Ambo, Rtn Anupam & Jigna Chaturvedi, Rtn Jigisha & Shrikant Parikh, Rtn Nishir Gordhandas, Rtn Renuka Joshi, Rtn Vicky Punjabi, Rtn Manoj Jalan and Radheshyam Jalan.
Project cost Rs 17,000/-
